REVIEW FAIL (code): Secret guard bypass — Evidence and judging contract, credential invariants (contracts/evidence-and-lock.md:91).
  WHERE: src/domain/model-qualification.ts:296-312
  EXPECTED: Reject authorization and cookie headers in evidence strings and reject values with the listed credential prefixes.
  ACTUAL: Cookie: session=fixture-session, Authorization: Basic Zml4dHVyZQ== and sk-fixture pass without throwing. The header pattern matches JSON keys and the prefix pattern requires eight trailing characters.
  FIX: Detect textual authorization and cookie headers as well as structured keys. Reject the listed token prefixes and add regression cases for each bypass.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Incomplete judge verdict can promote — Spec acceptance 2 and evidence contract unanimous non-regression.
  WHERE: src/domain/model-qualification.ts:124-137,204-210,236-251
  EXPECTED: Each verdict includes observedJudgeModel, with "unknown" for an unreported model, and explicitly reports false for the candidate regression flag.
  ACTUAL: evaluatePromotion returns { promote: true } when observedJudgeModel is omitted. It also promotes when optionBRegression is omitted for candidate B.
  FIX: Require a nonempty observedJudgeModel and both boolean regression fields. Accept explicit "unknown" or the requested judge model. Require the candidate regression flag to equal false. Test omitted fields.

  WHERE: src/ports/model-qualification-port.ts:24-63,84-88

REVIEW FAIL (code): Catalog and lock signatures break documented consumers — Qualification ports contract, ModelCatalogPort and RouteLockStorePort.
  WHERE: src/ports/model-qualification-port.ts:15-22,117-134
  EXPECTED: The documented catalog returns AdapterDiscoveryReport[]. The lock store accepts an unknown snapshot and documents writeRouteLockAtomic(scope, lock) returning Promise<string>.
